key_insight: GWDM combines wavelet-based diffusion with histopathology-specific guidance to generate realistic tissue patches for training-data augmentation.
clinical_relevance: Synthetic patches improved downstream nuclei and tissue segmentation in benchmark experiments, suggesting potential value for research on data-limited pathology AI.
method: Use wavelets to capture image details at multiple scales.
Condition generation on tissue patterns and staining variations.
Gradually introduce histomorphological guidance losses to stabilize training.
evidence_signal: Across BCSS, MoNuSeg, and PAIP2019, the authors report stronger generation performance than state-of-the-art comparators and improved segmentation when synthetic images augment real training data.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative effect sizes or external clinical validation, so real-world benefit and generalization remain uncertain.
paper_title: GWDM: A Guided Wavelet Diffusion Model for Realistic Histopathology Image Generation
